Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: finished full environment painting for a playable 2.5D Japanese anime game.
Input image 1 is the exact empty-room ground projection guide. Input image 2 is the APPROVED Emiya home painting: use it for brushwork, daylight, material richness and colour harmony only, not for its furniture or layout.
Paint over the guide into a complete beautiful background, preserving the camera and EXACT open walkable trapezoid: in a 1600x900 design space its rear corners are (390,435),(1140,435), front corners (38,812),(1560,812). Preserve those perspective rays, scale and ground height. Fill all edges of the entire canvas with coherent environment, not a floating platform or plain margin. Fixed moderately elevated front camera, straight vertical architecture, no fisheye, no camera rotation.
Soft Japanese animation background painting with natural warm daylight and cool blue-green shadow fill, subtle hand-painted edges and wood/paper/stone texture. Rich readable colours and fine detail, not blur, desaturation, plastic, low-poly or vector blocks.
The central floor and doorway approach corridors must be entirely EMPTY: furniture, benches, basin, counter, desk, shelves and futon are separate interactive objects drawn by the game and MUST NOT be baked into this background. Tiny wall-mounted decor and vegetation beyond the floor edges are fine. No characters, text, UI, labels, frames, watermark or duplicate inset scenes. Output one full landscape background at native approximately 16:9 resolution, at least 1600x900.
Location: Emiya residence FRONT entrance courtyard, separate from the rear engawa garden. View from just inside the street gate toward the Japanese timber house's genkan. Replace the guide's rear trees with the home's warm cedar and cream-plaster entrance facade and traditional blue-grey tiled eaves, its actual front doorway centred at x800 and meeting the ground near y450. A small wooden gate and aged plaster garden walls frame the near-left and near-right edges; do not block the centre of the near edge, where the player returns to the street. Quiet fine-gravel yard fills the exact floor trapezoid, with a clear flat stepping-stone route along its centre toward the genkan. Mature camphor branches and gardenia shrubs sit beyond the side edges, restrained moss and dappled sunlight. The whole central yard remains walkable; no flowerbeds intruding on the marked floor and no shed blocking routes. Capture the ordinary, lived-in Fuyuki home atmosphere rather than a grand temple.
